description.text: Accelerating Asia Ventures is the leading early-stage venture capital accelerator in Southeast Asia and South Asia with a focus on pre-Series A startups.

targetApplicants.text: We find high-potential founders in Southeast and South Asia—the ones with real traction and grit, but without the traditional background. Through our accelerator, we provide the capital, credibility, and hands-on partnership they need to get to the next level.

sources.quote: Asia's early stage accelerator VC fund that invests in high growth startups . Accelerating Asia exists to back the undiscovered. We find high-potential founders in Southeast and South Asia—the ones with real traction and grit, but without the traditional background. Through our accelerator, we provide the capital, credibility, and hands-on partnership they need to get to the next level. For our investor partners, we offer a trusted, systematic way to access and meaningfully engage with the future of innovation in the world's most dynamic markets.
